description: This file exports functions for loading include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest testing configuration specifically for the IRC extension tests within the openclaw project.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variable or returns null if not set.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a scoped Vitest configuration object for the IRC extension testing, using environment patterns or defaults.
